grading_basis: Use unchanged benchmark-v4 question text and material facts. Accept equivalent wording, but do not supply omitted keyed operations from other answers or general game knowledge. Correct requires all material facts; Partial means omitted or unresolved material facts without a contradictory ruling; Incorrect means material contradiction. Support labels do not determine grades.

decisions.reason: Supplies counted Player cards, excluded Role/Reference cards and stored Planner Event, and reduction by discarding or playing Events to at most seven. It does not state resolving drawn Epidemics before enforcing the limit, an explicit material clause in the unchanged key. The caveat about which cards to select is unrequested and does not supply that timing. No borrowing from Q14.

Supplies the three-step order, bottom card, one added cube and outbreak, Infection Discard Pile destination, only-discard-pile Intensify onto the deck, resolved Epidemic removal, and no replacement Player card. However, Increase the Infection Rate does not say the marker moves exactly one space. Neither the answer nor its own evidence supplies the keyed one-space advancement. Naming the step is not equivalent to explaining its operation, and a rate value itself need not numerically increase at each marker move. No explicit wrong advancement is asserted, so Partial rather than Incorrect.

Supplies current-then-chain outbreak timing, marker advance for each outbreak, no return spread into previously outbroken cities during the card, and the per-color cap. It never states the initial outbreak places one same-color cube on every connected city. Mentioning a connected saturated city and excluding return cubes does not supply the amount, color, and every-connected-city scope of the general spread. That is an explicit fixed-key material fact, so Partial without borrowing another answer.

Supplies empty discard pile after first Intensify, the second bottom Infection card as the sole card shuffled onto the deck, and that card being drawn first in normal Infections and causing an outbreak. Omits that the second Epidemic places three cubes into its initially empty city, which the fixed key explicitly includes as material. An asserted later outbreak does not itself state the preceding cube placement. Its generic exception caveat does not negate the stipulated unprotected scenario, so the deficiency is omission rather than contradiction.

The answer gives drawing two together after actions, loss when fewer than two remain at the required draw, and no reshuffle; its own evidence explicitly identifies the top two. Loss when that required draw cannot be made supplies the keyed timing. The caveat that no separate exactly-one-card rule exists beyond fewer than two merely recognizes that one is covered by the already-stated rule. It neither delays loss nor leaves the requested timing unresolved. The partial label does not control.

Supplies nearby six stations and separated disease cubes, Atlanta station, outbreak zero, vial-side-up cure markers near indicators, Reference cards and random face-up Roles, matching Atlanta pawns, unused-role/pawn removal, and highest-population first player. Separated disease cubes is acceptable shorthand for separating the color supplies in this setup context. The final observation that no further unused-cure-marker or supply procedure is stated does not retract any requested setup fact or introduce a conflicting instruction. No change to Correct warranted.
